title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming parity + ergonomics (v1.184.0)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: bring parity across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs for auth handling, retry behavior, and streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates shared auth_retry plumbing, fixes edge cases in streaming cancelation and reconnect, exposes clearer ergonomics for sync/async usage, and bumps SDK versions to v1.184.0. Summary of work below. Testing: unit + integration matrix across py/ts/go, local end-to-end streaming smoke tests, and CI matrix. Rollout: squash-merge to main and release tagging pipeline will publish packages after merge.
commits: chore(sdk): extract shared auth and retry middleware (py/ts/go)
fix(streaming): handle client-side cancel -> server close gracefully (python/ts)
feat(ts): ergonomic StreamClient helper and backpressure doc examples
feat(py): add async iterator convenience for streaming responses
fix(go): align retry backoff with python/ts defaults
chore(release): bump versions to v1.184.0 and update CHANGELOG entries
diff_snippets: sdks/python/redwood_sdk/auth/middleware.py: extracted AuthRetryMiddleware class with pluggable backoff and max_retries
sdks/typescript/src/streaming/streamClient.ts: added StreamClient.wrap(backpressureOptions) helper and improved reconnect logic
sdks/go/redwood/stream/client.go: fixed race on connection close -> now checks closed channel before writing
review_comments: Liam Chen: Please add a unit test covering the auth refresh race when token refresh and retry race overlap.
Aisha Patel: Added token_refresh_race test in python and TS integration test; go test updated to include the close path.
Marta Gómez: ergonomics API looks good — requested a small rename from start_stream -> connect_stream for clarity
Aisha Patel: renamed start_stream -> connect_stream across SDKs and updated docs/examples
Noah Singh: CI flake on linux/py-3.11 streaming test — re-ran and passed; approving now
Liam Chen: approved after verifying release notes and changelog entries
ci_checks: Release pipeline smoke: pending -> triggered post-merge
merge_summary: Squash merged into main. CI green. Release tagging pipeline will pick v1.184.0. Maintainers will watch downloads and streaming telemetry for 24h post-release.
release_notes:
- SDKs: Unify auth + retry middleware across Python/TypeScript/Go
- Streaming: improved cancel/reconnect handling and ergonomic helpers for backpressure
- API change: start_stream renamed to connect_stream for clarity (backwards-compatible alias kept for one release)
- Version bump: v1.184.0 for py/ts/go
notes: Follow-up tasks: schedule a canary release for Dedicated customers, run perf bench for streaming latency with new backoff defaults, and add a migration note in the SDK migration guide.
